"'''Can't You Hear My Heartbeat'''" is a song written by [[John Carter (English musician)|John Carter]] and [[Ken Lewis (songwriter)|Ken Lewis]], produced by [[Mickie Most]],<ref>[http://www.45cat.com/record/k13310 Herman's Hermits, "Can't You Hear My Heartbeat" single release] Retrieved February 2, 2014</ref> and performed by [[Herman's Hermits]]. It reached No. 2 on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]],<ref>[http://www.musicvf.com/song.php?title=Can%27t+You+Hear+My+Heartbeat+by+Herman%27s+Hermits&id=19154 Herman's Hermits, "Can't You Hear My Heartbeat" Chart Positions] Retrieved February 2, 2014</ref>  and no. 1 in the [[Cashbox (magazine)|Cashbox]] charts,<ref>{{cite web |title=It was 50 years ago today |url=https://www.rebeatmag.com/it-was-50-years-ago-today-cant-you-hear-my-heartbeat-by-hermans-hermits/ |website=Rebeat |access-date=10 November 2025}}</ref> in 1965.

In the United Kingdom it was released as the B-Side of "[[Silhouettes (The Rays song)|Silhouettes]]". The song was featured on their 1965 album, ''[[Herman's Hermits on Tour|Their Second Album! Herman's Hermits on Tour]]''.<ref>[http://www.discogs.com/Hermans-Hermits-Their-Second-Album-Hermans-Hermits-On-Tour/release/1725421 Herman's Hermits, ''Their Second Album! Herman's Hermits on Tour''] Retrieved February 2, 2014</ref>

''[[Billboard Hot 100|Billboard]]'' magazine's Top ''[[Billboard Hot 100|Hot 100]]'' songs of [[1965 in music|1965]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://longboredsurfer.com/charts/1965.php|title=Billboard Top 100 - 1965|accessdate=February 2, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140102174420/http://longboredsurfer.com/charts/1965.php|archive-date=2014-01-02|url-status=dead}}</ref> ranked it No.8.

"Can't You Hear My Heartbeat" is a song written by John Carter and Ken Lewis, produced by Mickie Most, and performed by Herman's Hermits. It reached No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100,  and no. 1 in the Cashbox charts, in 1965.

In the United Kingdom it was released as the B-Side of "Silhouettes". The song was featured on their 1965 album, Their Second Album! Herman's Hermits on Tour.

Billboard magazine's Top Hot 100 songs of 1965 ranked it No.8.
